answers.explanation: The writer finds it notable that Spaceship Earth came with no instruction book, which is the feature the passage highlights.
The passage says the missing manual forced man to discover things for himself, which challenged his inquisitive nature.
Because man had to keep experimenting and learning without a manual, the passage implies he is constantly searching for knowledge.
The passage ends on a hopeful note about learning how to survive safely, so the writer's mood is optimistic.
Stress is something people understand through their own experience, so it is better understood when experienced.
The passage stresses that people can control most of their stress through their own choices, so stress is better handled by the individual.
The passage says mastering stress means changing behaviour, thinking and lifestyle, which means changing one's attitude to stressors.
Experts say most stress is self-generated, so people can control it because it is individually initiated.
The passage says most stress is self-generated, so stress is largely an individually induced problem.

Democratic governance is the indicator of an ethical standard of governance given in the passage.
The passage concludes that fighting corruption is essential to promoting good governance.
